title: Distinguish per-window StateInner evidence coverage from lifetime loss counters
outcome: StateInner observer evidence distinguishes coverage of the observed wait window from cumulative process-lifetime loss and eviction totals.
acceptance: Define per-window coverage semantics with independent concurrence before implementation.
Keep cumulative loss and eviction totals available as informational counters while partial/unavailable reflect any missing coverage for the requested window.
Deterministic tests cover a fully retained recent window after historical evictions and a window whose relevant holder was lost or evicted.
